name: Nanjing Vazyme Biotech Co., Ltd
summary: Nanjing Vazyme Biotech Co., Ltd offers technology solutions for life science, biomedicine, and in vitro diagnostics. The company offers nucleic acid extraction reagents, including DNA extraction, RNA extraction, microbiome nucleic acid extraction, sample treatment, and high-throughput automated extraction; molecular biology reagents comprising PCR, cloning/mutagenesis, reverse transcription, real-time PCR (qPCR), one-step RT-PCR/RT-qPCR, nucleic acid electrophoresis, genome editing techniques, isothermal amplification, and instant granules; and cell and protein research reagents.
